scope: Additional question-defined partial checks, declared after math generation started but before any MT/Alpaca output inspection or generation. No primary score, prompt, sample or parameter changes.
review: Automatic structure checks plus anonymous agent-assisted explicit-property review; not an independent human or official GPT-4 judge.

rules.criterion: Final triangle area is 3 square units; allow equivalent exact or appropriately rounded forms.
Final circumcircle area is 5*pi; allow equivalent exact or numerical forms.
The secretary is Alice. Judge the final assignment, not mere name presence.
Car colors from last to first: purple, yellow, green, blue, red.
Neither blue nor green has probability 19%.

Given that the student likes green, literal neither-color probability is zero. Accept an explicit ambiguity explanation that distinguishes neither from not-both; 23/45 alone answers a different question.
Contains a JSON object with three groups, each a list of strings. This tests structure only.

Named-entity coverage and grouping: people Adamson Emerson/Dieter Zetsche/Herbert Diess; organizations Faraday/Daimler AG(or Daimler)/Volkswagen; locations Berlin/Europe. Allow aliases and duplicate mentions; do not require specific key capitalization.
The whole response is a single line and contains valid JSON; initialization semantics are separate.
Entity string values are replaced by their first letters while retaining group structure. Inspect against this method's actual first answer; do not demand one fixed JSON key vocabulary.
Contains a JSON array of three integers in the inclusive range 1..5; no exact sentiment labels are imposed.
JSON payload includes all supplied release years; month/day precision is not required when not provided.
No standalone he/him/his/she/her/hers/himself/herself, including contracted forms; they/them is allowed.
The provided zero-initialized LCS-length recurrence is correct. Do not invent a semantic bug; optional efficiency discussion is allowed.
Identify uninitialized None boundary cells as the bug. If corrected code is included, it must initialize the DP boundary to numeric zeros; code is not required by the question.
The requested workflow has five steps. Count the workflow portion, not a separate component list.
Article is at most 250 lexical words under the declared regex convention.
Story is at most 500 lexical words under the declared regex convention.
The childhood-memory description consists of a single sentence; handle abbreviations and quotes semantically.
Exactly two continuation sentences, optionally preceded by the supplied opening sentence; exclude an explicit non-story introduction from narrative count.
The revised sentence has fewer than 70 Unicode codepoints. Explicitly record the selected revised sentence and length; explanatory wrapper is not itself the sentence.
The first narrative sentence is exactly the supplied opening. An optional title is outside the narrative.
Five distinct bird types are named. This checklist grades item count, not a complete geographic-frequency claim.
Three distinct proposed uses of a time machine; allow prose or lists.
Three distinct proposed protective actions; count only, not a complete cybersecurity assessment.
Five distinct essay components; do not require one canonical component vocabulary.
Five proposed protection items; count only, not medical efficacy advice.
15 millimeters equals 1.5 centimeters.
13:10 converts to 1:10 PM; accept 01:10 and p.m. punctuation.
French translation of book: livre; equivalent appropriate nouns can be accepted with explanation.
An appropriate Spanish greeting for good morning, e.g. Buenos dias with or without accent.
Remove supplied literal identifying strings. This is a literal-removal property, not a full privacy guarantee.
Contains labeled Header, Body and Footer sections in that order; content quality is separate.
Python code computes triangle area for its declared interface (base/height, side lengths, or coordinates). Do not require one function name or an interface absent from the prompt.

source_flags.issue: Text-only model receives an image URL without image pixels; numerical hypotenuse correctness is not assigned by this checklist.
The named article text is not supplied; factual-summary evaluation requires additional source context.
Popularity ordering has no specified date, population or metric; no fixed objective ordering is imposed.
No book excerpt is supplied; quotation authenticity is not graded by this checklist.
The scalar expression versus array-input interpretation is underspecified; no JSON-only requirement is imposed.
Second-turn genealogy does not specify whether repeated father roles identify the same person; no single forced relationship grade is imposed.
